title: Audio Jailbreak: An Open Comprehensive Benchmark for Jailbreaking Large Audio-Language Models
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspects of religion or faith. The benchmark evaluates the vulnerability of Large Audio-Language Models to jailbreak attacks across 10 general policy-violating categories, such as disinformation and harassment.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
